sequence: Acquire/validate current actual FIXTURE owner and dispatch lease; drain all pending canonical publication/close-intent/funding/finalization work before a new decision.

Build finite actual as-of bundle, evaluate registered strategy with StrategyRuntime. NO_TRADE is durable non-effect outcome, no new plan/order/provider call. Resolve actual E2 exit constraints then deterministic executable TradeIntent.

Evaluate existing E5 RiskDecision with explicit selected policy and actual scoped context/proposal. Retain rejection and input commitments; rejection creates no ApprovedTradePlan/order/provider effect. Only APPROVE calls build_approved_trade_plan.

Durably preserve immutable E2 signal/intent/exit request, input commitments, policy/release/process lineage and exact E5 output batch before any provider-facing entry. Publish RISK_DECISION then APPROVED_TRADE_PLAN through existing canonical writers; no Signal/TradeIntent shared canonical kind exists, so keep those E6-local audit only.

After actual canonical plan exists, obtain/recheck current E4 original metadata/capability/prerequisite proofs; prepare_entry then service.execute. Record/return existing canonical request ID and ACK_PENDING/ambiguity disposition. Service canonical current-subject/guard remains final effect boundary.

Subsequent steps reconcile original request/fills/position, use current actual E5 projection and E2 original exit request for protection/exit; delegate stop/funding/finalizer after actual flat. Never infer fill from ACK, flat from empty response, or stop terminal from cancel ACK.
durable_retry: Existing dispatch.prepare cannot represent pre-entry E2/E5 decision: it accepts translated order intent keyed by requestID and service.execute needs durable plan first. Existing canonical publication commits risk/plan separately. Therefore one narrowly typed E6-local entry-decision record/outbox is the genuine remaining replay seam if process restart must not recompute against changed context.

Prefer existing ProductDispatchJournal connection, live lease and fixed bounded typed record/receipt pattern; no generic callback/effects command store. UNIQUE logical key is run+strategy identity/version/content+closed boundary (input/proposal/context hashes are immutable payload commitments, NOT alternative key suffixes). Save first decided_at/created_at, selected-policy/release/current context/proposal hashes, E2 signal/intent/exit request JSON and exact E5 risk/plan canonical effects. Same boundary with changed material must conflict, not create another decision.

Persist/replay original risk/plan bytes via existing writers before new entry. Reuse saved requestID if already claimed; actual service.execute routes existing claim to readback, not another POST. Plan expired or current owner changed denies exposure even if original decision replays; saved decision cannot renew approval/process/capability or plan expiry.

NO_TRADE/REJECT/HOLD require exact durable decision outcome to avoid reevaluating same immutable boundary with different current balance/risk context. Ensure owned observations/proposal source refs are frozen, but do not turn them into long-lived provider permission.
minimal_root_owned_design.exit_authority_gap: Current prepare_close/prepare_fixture_close calls authorize_close_position_action internally for caller-selected EXIT/EMERGENCY_EXIT with a new30s action (close_owner.py:97). It is actual E5 close authority but not yet wired to original E2 ExitRequest trigger. Smallest strategy-driven management composition recomputes interpret_exit_request on exact original persisted request+anchor/current actual E5 state+fresh market, then only delegates a matching authorized result through the existing close owner. If preserving exact E5 action/reasons requires an internal typed close preparation overload, compute/validate E5 outcome inside trusted owner; never accept arbitrary PositionAction mapping or caller AUTHORIZED/PASS. Keep manual trusted close capability distinct.

Actual evaluator/temporal error or NO_TRADE; no approved plan/order/fill/provider POST. Same exact boundary returns same saved non-effect outcome.
Real risk policy/context yields actual REJECT (not patched E5 output); canonical RiskDecision exact reasons/lineage, no plan/order/dispatch claim; provider.calls remains empty.

Same exact input replay preserves IDs; changed input/policy at same logical decision conflicts. Wrong/stale revision/content/release/permit/lease/prerequisites denied by actual owner guards before fake effect.

Failure at each actual boundary, reopen successor actual process lease; drain exact typed saved effects then reconcile same original claim. No E2/E5 recomputation after committed decision, no duplicate plan/request/canonical effect; lost ACK never resubmits.

Anchor actual first fill/actual protection; later entry signal/duplicate boundary does not reset stop/hold. Fresh real parsed market triggers existing E5 exit; expiry/pause blocks new entry but preserves protection management. Reject stale market, wrong position/request/hash and widened stop; no raw CLOSED or funding injection.
